Made up for testing: a small mammal collection, where a catalogued specimen is kept as several
pieces.

- `specimens.csv`: one row per catalogued specimen, with its collecting event and name.
- `parts.csv`: every piece kept, with its own number, preparation and disposition. `kind` says
  whether it is a part of the specimen (skin, skull, skeleton) or a subsample taken from it
  (frozen liver, with when and by whom it was taken).
